title: Austin's Water Protection and Downtown Growth
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened a special, closed-door meeting for legal advice on key city issues.
*   A primary focus was discussing the "Save Our Springs Initiative Ordinance," a significant environmental policy aimed at protecting local water resources.
*   Council members also deliberated on plans for acquiring land to develop new Convention Center parking facilities.
*   No final decisions or votes were taken during this special session.
transcript:

March 12, 1992 - OFFICE OF THE MAYOR
Mayor Todd called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Mayor Pro
Tern Urdy. The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to go into Executive
Session, pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated to receive
advice from Legal Counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and
personnel matters. No final action, decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on
